Name: HarveyPlus
Author: possumbreath
Description:
[center][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]

This mod began from the simple desire to have more post-marriage dialogue variety and inevitably evolved into a full overhaul. If you're like me, you like starting new farms but despite your best efforts you just keep marrying the same guy every time. This mod introduces the possibility of discovering new content on consecutive playthroughs, hopefully helping to keep things fresh! It is also made with players who do [b]NOT[/b] date Harvey in mind, with a stronger focus on the arc of your friendship so that (hopefully) 8 hearts feels more like a fitting conclusion. 

Harvey is now no longer the player's doctor, eliminating the ethical issues there if that's something you also weren't too fond of. This is addressed in a new introductory event. Other events have been tweaked to bring his actions more in line with his presented character: as I've said to other people while working on this mod, if you show me a guy who is supposed to be very concerned with doing his job well, then you have to show him doing his job well. Most notably his 2 heart event with George has been completely changed (and will also result in a small schedule change for George where he joins Evelyn outside when the weather is nice). I am by no means a medical professional, but I was raised by doctors and am married to a nurse, and I have tried to the best of my ability to represent best practices as I understand them. If you spot anything I have glaringly wrong, please let me know!

A secondary goal was to have Harvey and Maru actually interact onscreen, developing their friendship past 'they stand next to each other at a lot of events'. I think that they could have a delightful friendship if it was given any focus (I am one late night bad decision away from starting a full Maru overhaul as well). 

Overall my goal was to bulk up his character, make both his romantic and platonic arcs with the player feel more concrete and considered, and combat repetitive dialogue in a way that makes it fun to actually read what the character is saying on the off chance you discover a line you haven't seen before.

[line]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]

Download the mod ZIP file and extract it into your Mods folder, and you should be good to go!

This mod only requires SMAPI and Content Patcher to run, but I also recommend GMCM for ease of use and Harvey's New Mustache because it's a mod I personally can't play without.

[line]

[size=4][b]Main Features[/b][/size]

[b]Seasonal Dialogue:[/b] Harvey has dialogue both pre- and post-marriage that changes with the seasons and his heart level.

[b]Extra Dialogue:[/b] Many lines have been given alternate options that the game will randomly pick from, including: rainy day dialogue, all gift reactions, and quite a few marriage lines. In addition, some dialogue will change to a more personal/romantic version when the player is dating Harvey but not yet married to him.

[b]New Mail:[/b] Two new event-related letters, with more planned for future updates.

[b]Edited Events:[/b] All events have been edited and in some cases replaced entirely with new events (4 and 6).

[b]New Events:[/b] A new introductory event has been added, with more planned for future updates to flesh out a more complete arc.

[b]Schedule Changes:[/b] Harvey will now leave the house on Mondays when married, either going for a nature walk or to the library. 

[b]Death Penalty Changes:[/b] Players have the option to decide what kind of penalty they incur when they die when married to Harvey (sir, we are married, we have a shared bank account, what is the point of charging me). In addition, the PlayerKilled dialogue changes depending on whether Harvey and the player are romantic or not. This can be configured in settings if you use other mods that edit this event!

[line]

[size=4][b]Future Update Plans[/b][/size]

[b]More New Events:[/b] An entirely new 14 Heart event (current 14 has been moved to 12) is in the works, and I also plan to add at least one or two events between 8 and 10 to make the dating period actually feel like you're dating.

[b]Rival Hearts:[/b] An (optional, configurable) rival hearts storyline. Maru will be the default partner, but far future plans include adding Leah as another option - and maybe more if I get really spicy?

[b]Parenthood:[/b] More events relating to player children, likely adding content via other mods that make children real characters.

[line]

[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]

This mod [b]MAY[/b] conflict with any other mods that heavily edit Harvey's dialogue and events, since they'll be fighting to edit the same keys.

This mod [b]IS[/b] compatible with SVE (the balloon event has been moved away from the railroad).

If you run into an issue or are interested in making my mod compatible with yours, let me know!

[line]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]

Abagaianye and Koda, who have been listening to me yell about this since I started working on it two years ago, and without whom it probably would not have gotten finished. 

Lucy, for letting me make her playtest by insisting we install it into our modded multiplayer farm.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]My beautiful wife, for putting up with me asking them way too many finicky medical questions.[/center]
